# Itunda Developers

> Developer platform for building apps and integrations on Itunda.

Itunda Developers: https://developers.itunda.im/

## Core resources

- [Getting started](https://developers.itunda.im/#itunda-product-content): Start building and understand the developer journey.
- [Products](https://developers.itunda.im/#itunda-dev-products): Apps, Payments, Business, Identity, Place and Platform.
- [API guidance](https://developers.itunda.im/#itunda-product-content): Authentication, permissions, API lifecycle, errors and rate limits.
- [Security](https://developers.itunda.im/#itunda-dev-security): Credential handling, authorization and server-side boundaries.
- [Troubleshooting](https://developers.itunda.im/#itunda-dev-observability): Request IDs, logs and platform status.
- [Launch](https://developers.itunda.im/#itunda-dev-final): Integration review and production launch flow.

## Verified API contract

- API namespace: /api/v1
- Verified aggregate OpenAPI: GET /openapi.json
- Service-local OpenAPI: GET /v3/api-docs

The aggregate contract is generated from the actual Spring service schemas behind the API gateway. It fails closed if a registered service cannot provide its contract.

## Development model

1. Choose a product capability.
2. Read the verified OpenAPI contract.
3. Create credentials with minimum required permissions.
4. Build and test in the appropriate environment.
5. Validate security and integration behavior.
6. Request production access and launch.

## Rules

- Never invent endpoints, fields, permissions, SDK behavior or error codes.
- Keep credentials and access tokens server-side.
- Use the minimum permissions required.
- Treat API responses and payment state as server-authoritative.
- Preserve X-Request-ID when reporting failures.
- Respect rate limits and use exponential backoff.
- Do not perform undocumented production mutations.
